WGI, country GPR, export and REER log changes, and capital-flow volatility

The x-axis is fixed to the 2001–2023 frame. WGI is annual; GPR and capital-flow volatility are annual means of monthly values. Export and real effective exchange rate (REER) changes are ln(annual mean in year t) − ln(annual mean in year t−1), using available monthly observations in each year. Nominal exports are in domestic currency. Sources: input/monthly nominal export.xlsx and cleaned/real effective exchange rate.xlsx. Missing years are not bridged; REER is unavailable for some countries. Each series is indexed independently from its first available value inside the frame; a change equal to its full observed range is 100 index points. This is not a percent-growth index. Values are plotted wherever available, and gaps are not imputed. Correlations use unindexed annual values and pairwise-complete observations.

Pooled correlations by six WGI institution aspects

Each country-series is standardized within country before pooling, so coefficients reflect within-country co-movement rather than cross-country level differences. n and country counts can vary by pair. Capital-flow volatility overlaps with 11 of 17 countries in the main panel.

Global controls

Annual means of monthly natural logs of WTI oil price, VIX and current-price GEPU. Sources: cleaned/oil_price.csv, cleaned/vix.csv and cleaned/gepu_current.csv. Each series is full-range scaled to 100 in its first available year; hover to see the unindexed log value. Missing observations are not imputed.

Global controls: log changes

VIX is the annual mean of monthly ln(VIX). For GEPU and oil, change is the annual mean of monthly logs in year t minus the annual mean in year t−1; 2000 is used to calculate the 2001 change. Missing years are not bridged. Each series is full-range scaled to 100 in its first available year; hover to see the unindexed value.

Country-specific controls

Policy rate and year-on-year inflation are annual means of available monthly observations; government gross debt/GDP and the IMF financial-development index are annual. Sources: cleaned/policy_rate.csv, cleaned/inflation.csv, cleaned/debt_gdp.csv and cleaned/replication_cleaned/country_month.csv. The IMF index is unavailable for some countries and ends in 2021. Select a variable to see one chart per dashboard country with data. Each chart uses original values and its own y-axis scale; missing observations are not imputed.

Country-specific capital-flow volatility

Source: cleaned/replication_cleaned/country_month.csv, the monthly standard deviation of portfolio inflows over three months. The plotted annual value is the mean of available monthly volatility observations; the base-100 index uses the first available year for that country and the full-period range.
